name: Rigel-VS
description: A Tessera Materials variable-stiffness composite using a magnetorheological elastomer core sandwiched between carbon-fiber skins, capable of transitioning from pliable rubber-like flexibility to near-rigid structural hardness in under 80 milliseconds when a magnetic field is applied via embedded coil networks. Rigel-VS panels and sheets can be locally stiffened in zones, allowing complex morphing behaviors — a flat sheet that selectively hardens into a structural brace, or a garment that locks rigid around an impact site. Field collapse returns it to full flexibility instantly.
story_hooks: A Rigel-VS garment's embedded coils have been sabotaged — in a fight, the armor will lock rigid at the wrong moment, trapping the wearer mid-movement.
Military-grade Rigel-VS panels are showing up in Shelf gang armor — someone is running a serious supply operation through official channels.
A character needs to pass a security scan: their Rigel-VS armor can go fully flexible and disguise itself as civilian clothing, but only if the power cell holds.
